citations.claim: pre-impact upward speed ~15 m/s just below ceiling
post-impact downward speed more than doubled to ~35 m/s despite e=0.7
total energy jumps from ~219.8 J to ~722.7 J at the ceiling bounce, first violating energy_bound

counterfactual.change: Lower initial upward velocity from 17.16 to 5.0 so the body never reaches the ceiling; all else identical. Energy stays ~85 J and no violation occurs, showing the ceiling contact injects the energy.

explanation: Single body rises and contacts the arena ceiling between steps 625 and 626. Incoming speed ~14.99 m/s with e=0.7 should rebound at ~10.5 m/s, but observed rebound is 35.08 m/s with energy jumping 219.8->722.7 J and no controller work. e=0 still violates, so restitution is not the cause. Likely cause is faulty ceiling boundary collision resolution (impulse sign/error and/or positional correction adding velocity) that injects kinetic energy on a high-speed grazing/penetrating top-wall contact with tiny dt=3.5e-4.
vision_note: A single blue circle sits touching the top arena boundary in steps 623 through 625 and remains there in step 626 with almost no visible displacement. No large rebound, penetration through the wall, or other dramatic motion is visible in the strip.
